title: Console AI approvals: show a lapsed pending action as Expired, not Rejected, in the chat card and the AI Approvals inbox
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ① the console half of objectstack-ai/cloud#4608 (maintainer ruling 6904228929 on that card: a lapsed item is shown as expired, not as rejected), named in the contract review of objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4647 (record 6905692497, S2). Dedupe: `pending action expired lapsed approvals inbox` finds no card.
Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4608 (hosted and self-hosted in-app AI).

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：AI 待确认操作 7 天没人处理会自动失效；聊天里的确认卡片和「AI 审批」收件箱要把这种条目显示为「已过期」，不是「已拒绝」。
- 为什么：裁决 A（cloud#4608）明确要求显示为过期；现在界面会把它显示成「被拒绝，原因 lapsed」，看起来像是有人拒绝了。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

- Since cloud#4608 an in-app AI pending action nobody decided within 7 days is stored `status: 'rejected'`, `rejection_reason: 'lapsed'`, `decided_by` empty (no new `PendingActionStatus` value).
- The approve and reject doors answer such an item `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `error.details.reason: 'pending_action_lapsed'`; GET `/api/v1/ai/pending-actions[/:id]` returns the row as above.
- The chat's inline pending-approval card and the `ai:approvals` inbox render that row as "Rejected" with reason "lapsed", which reads as if the person refused it.
- Ask (the console renders): when `status === 'rejected' && rejection_reason === 'lapsed' && !decided_by`, show "Expired" (not answered in time, or the proposer lost access) and no "Rejected by"; on a 409 with `details.reason === 'pending_action_lapsed'`, show the same and refresh the item instead of a generic conflict error.
- Done when both surfaces show "Expired" for a lapsed row and for the 409, with a test each; a person's own rejection (`decided_by` set) still shows "Rejected".

Reader: framework console lane (chat pending-approval card, `ai:approvals` inbox).
